research_notes: OrcaRouter is an OpenAI-compatible AI gateway at https://api.orcarouter.ai/v1.
GET /v1/models returns 204 models spanning orcarouter/* routing models and provider models (anthropic/*, openai/*, deepseek/*, google/*).
POST /v1/chat/completions is OpenAI-compatible; verified live with orcarouter/fusion-flash returning HTTP 200.

The gateway exposes a provider/model namespace like OpenRouter, but adds adaptive routing, automatic failover, zero-markup inference, observability, guardrails, and agent-tool governance on the same endpoint.
The catalog repo already publishes an openrouter CLI under library/ai/openrouter; orcarouter mirrors that shape as a first-class named provider.
Command set is intentionally focused: doctor, models, models get, chat, auth, auth set, version.
